newsitem.title: UK: LME to launch average price options on Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: LME to launch average price options on Feb 3.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) will launch trading in its two new Traded Average Price Options (TAPOS) on Monday February 3.
In a news release the LME said the introduction of copper grade A and high grade primary aluminium TAPOS is a first for any commodity futures and options exchange worldwide.
"Unlike LME traded options, TAPOS are priced off the average futures price of an entire month, rather than off a specific day," the LME said.
Producers and consumers have for several years been hedging using the average price of a month to protect against physical fluctuations.
In the past, many members have been offering OTC (over-the-counter) Asian options, based on the LME monthly average settlement price.
By introducing TAPOS, granters and takers of options will benefit from greater liquidity, greater transparency, efficiency and the protection provided by the clearing house.
"More importantly, the LME will have regulatory jurisdiction over average price options traded on the Exchange," the LME added.
